apps.localizedDescription:
A native app to watch and manage your self-hosted services from one place, even when they sit behind a login proxy.

• 36 services, including Portainer, Proxmox, TrueNAS, Beszel, Dockge, Scrutiny, Nginx Proxy Manager, Pi-hole, Plex and the Servarr stack
• Several instances of each service, with fallback addresses
• Forward auth, two-factor codes and OAuth sign-in for Beszel
• Encrypted backups, PIN and biometric unlock
• Bookmarks and a Tailscale shortcut
• English, Italian, French, Spanish and German

privacy.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Rackwarden uses Face ID to quickly unlock the app.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Rackwarden needs to access your local network to communicate with your self-hosted services.
